explain.ar: نستعمل am مع I، وis مع he وshe وit، وare مع you وwe وthey. مثل: I am Ali = أنا علي.

title.ar: ضمائر الملكية: my / your / his / her

title.ar: يوجد: there is / there are وحروف المكان

explain.fr: there is = il y a (singulier), there are = il y a (pluriel). Prépositions : in = dans, on = sur, under = sous, next to = à côté de.
explain.en: Use there is for one thing and there are for many. Places: in, on, under, next to.

explain.en: Use the present simple for habits. Add s with he, she, it: I play, he plays. Some verbs add es: go, goes.

title.ar: الماضي البسيط: was / were والأفعال المنتظمة
title.fr: Le passé simple : was / were et verbes réguliers
title.en: Past simple: was / were and regular verbs

explain.ar: للماضي نضيف ed للفعل المنتظم: watch → watched، visit → visited. وفعل الكون في الماضي: was مع I وhe وshe وit، وwere مع you وwe وthey. والسؤال بـ Did: Did you walk?
explain.fr: Au passé, on ajoute ed aux verbes réguliers : watch → watched, visit → visited. Le verbe être : was avec I, he, she, it et were avec you, we, they. Question avec Did : Did you walk?
explain.en: Regular past verbs add ed: watched, visited. The past of be is was (I, he, she, it) and were (you, we, they). Questions use Did.

title.fr: Le passé simple des verbes irréguliers

explain.fr: Beaucoup de verbes courants ne prennent pas ed au passé ; leur forme s'apprend : go → went, take → took, buy → bought, see → saw, fly → flew. À la question et à la négation, on revient à la base avec did : Did you go? I didn't go.
explain.en: Many common verbs have special past forms: go → went, take → took, buy → bought, see → saw, fly → flew. With did, use the base verb: Did you go? I didn't go.

explain.en: used to plus a verb is a past habit that stopped. be used to plus a noun or ing verb means being familiar with something: I am used to waking up early.

title.ar: المجهول مع أفعال القول: It is said that
title.fr: Le passif avec les verbes de parole : It is said that
title.en: Passive reporting: It is said that…

explain.ar: في الأسلوب العلمي والصحفي ننقل الآراء دون ذكر قائلها: It is believed that… = يُعتقد أن… أو The vaccine is thought to be safe = يُظن أن اللقاح آمن. ومثلها: is said, is known, is reported, is expected.
explain.fr: Dans le style scientifique ou journalistique, on rapporte une opinion sans citer son auteur : It is believed that… = On croit que… ou The vaccine is thought to be safe = On pense que le vaccin est sûr. Aussi : is said, is known, is reported, is expected.
explain.en: In formal writing we report beliefs without naming who holds them: It is believed that… or The vaccine is thought to be safe. Others: is said, is known, is reported, is expected.

title.ar: التقديم والتأخير للتوكيد: Never have I…
title.fr: L'inversion pour l'emphase : Never have I…
title.en: Inversion for emphasis: Never have I…

explain.ar: في الأسلوب الأدبي القوي نبدأ بكلمة نفي أو تقييد ثم نقدّم الفعل المساعد على الفاعل: Never have I seen such beauty = لم أرَ جمالًا كهذا قط. ومثلها: Rarely, Not only… but also, Hardly… when, Only then.
explain.fr: Dans un style soutenu, on commence par un mot négatif ou restrictif puis on place l'auxiliaire avant le sujet : Never have I seen such beauty = Jamais je n'ai vu une telle beauté. Aussi : Rarely, Not only… but also, Hardly… when, Only then.
explain.en: In formal style, start with a negative or limiting word, then put the auxiliary before the subject: Never have I seen such beauty. Also: Rarely, Not only… but also, Hardly… when, Only then.

title.fr: Le souhait : I wish / If only

explain.ar: I wish + ماضٍ بسيط = تمنٍّ لحاضر مختلف: I wish I had more time = ليت عندي وقتًا أكثر. وI wish + had + التصريف الثالث = ندم على الماضي: I wish I had invested earlier. وIf only أقوى في المعنى.
explain.fr: I wish + prétérit = souhait d'un présent différent : I wish I had more time = Si seulement j'avais plus de temps. I wish + had + participe = regret du passé : I wish I had invested earlier. If only est plus fort.
explain.en: I wish plus past simple is a wish about the present. I wish plus had done is a regret about the past. If only is a stronger version.

title.ar: الاستنتاج عن الماضي: must have / might have / can't have
title.fr: La déduction au passé : must have / might have / can't have
title.en: Past deduction: must have / might have / can't have

explain.ar: نستنتج ما حدث في الماضي بـ modal + have + التصريف الثالث: must have = لا بد أنه (متأكد)، might / could have = ربما، can't have = مستحيل أن. مثل: He must have studied a lot.
explain.fr: Pour déduire ce qui s'est passé : modal + have + participe passé. must have = il a sûrement, might / could have = il a peut-être, can't have = il n'a sûrement pas. Ex. : He must have studied a lot.
explain.en: Make deductions about the past with modal + have + past participle: must have (sure), might or could have (possible), can't have (impossible).

explain.en: Highlight ideas with cleft sentences: What I need is time. It was Ali who won. Link ideas with however, therefore, moreover and although.
